criteria.contract: A living incumbent and local consenting adult direct household member nominate and separately confirm a voluntary head-office succession; nomination alone changes no authority and no personal membership/service/troops/property is automatically transferred

Runtime head authority uses dated office history across political, administrative, military and new service entry points while initial scenario and past proofs remain unchanged; former head loses fresh head authority

House salary debts and outstanding freight retain original owner, principal, receiver, stock and obligation; the new head and relevant counterparty individually acknowledge an original before current-house payment or fixed-site settlement, without forgiving or duplicating debts or cargo

Old personal service, active military commands, dated correspondence and prior delegation records are preserved as original agreements rather than rewritten to the successor; pending/unknown remote succession is not shown as live player knowledge

Normal entry, stale/duplicate/refused/absent/tampered operations, actual generation recovery/future equality, old version byte compatibility and headless3D data are verified separately from GUI/appearance

limits: Explicit v21 local living incumbent and consenting adult direct member only. Nominate/confirm/scheduled resolution; actual office history, immutable scenario/organization ownership/personal bonds/troops/assets. Original salary/freight individually acknowledged and settled, not mass-transferred. Death, lineage/adoption/wills, contested succession, annexation, same-garrison military issuer transition, incumbent personal-service cleanup, old delegation reauthorization and treaty/hostage succession remain deferred. Existing military principal/proofs are not rewritten. Full3363/GUI NOT_RUN.
